title: Curve
description: A control that you write as a curve over the song (auto, lfo or env, like a parameter) so that one curve can steer several parameters.

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: The curve: auto(bar:value, ...), lfo(period, low, high) or env(...). Values are in the unit of the control; without a unit the control is a level from 0 to 1000 (per mille).

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: The unit of the control this block makes. none: a general control (a level from 0 to 1) that is scaled to the range of the parameter it steers. Hz, dB, ...: a typed control that only steers a parameter in that unit; the range is then written in that unit.
